title: Strategy-Zoo Multiple Testing & Vol-Targeting Leverage Blowup: Two Destruction Mechanisms
content: Two distinct failure mechanisms destroy macro strategy books independently of whether the underlying signal has genuine edge. First, the multiple-testing problem: when a researcher or PM evaluates hundreds of strategy variants, parameters, or universes and selects the best performer, the reported Sharpe ratio is inflated by selection bias — Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016) documented 316+ published factors and argue the t-statistic hurdle must rise from 2.0 to above 3.0; Bailey & Lopez de Prado's Deflated Sharpe Ratio (2014) and Minimum Track Record Length formalize the haircut required to distinguish genuine alpha from the best draw from a noise distribution, with the haircut growing non-linearly in the number of trials tested. False Discovery Rate methods (Barras et al. 2010) confirm most funds or factors that survive naive significance filters are false positives; the remedy is pre-registered hypothesis counts, Bonferroni or BHY correction, and a track record long enough that even a zero-alpha strategy could not plausibly have generated the observed Sharpe. Second, the sizing/leverage pathology: vol-targeting strategies mechanically lever up when realized volatility compresses during calm regimes, concentrating gross exposure precisely when the risk-reward is worst; when volatility spikes — as in February 2018 (Volmageddon) — those same mechanical rules force synchronous de-grossing, selling into the spike and amplifying it endogenously; the XIV/SVXY inverse-VIX ETN implosion (92% loss in one session) is the extreme archetype, but the same loop operates in any short-gamma or carry book that is overleveraged relative to Kelly-optimal sizing, where even a strategy with positive expected value achieves ruin probability approaching 1 under persistent overbetting.
lesson: Selection across a zoo of strategies inflates the apparent Sharpe by an amount that grows with trial count and must be deflated before any capital commitment; a strategy that survives this filter can still be destroyed by its own sizing rule if vol-targeting levers it up into calm and then forces mechanical selling into the spike — genuine edge and mechanical ruin are not mutually exclusive.
